rules.title: Rent Stabilization Ordinance (RSO)
rules.requirement: Rent for covered units may be increased once every 12 months by the allowable annual percentage set by the city; rent may go to market rate after certain vacancies/evictions. Additional increases require LAHD approval through specific programs.
rules.key_value: One increase per 12 months by the allowable rent increase percentage (figure in linked PDF)
rules.citation: Rent Stabilization Ordinance (RSO); LAMC Section 151.28 (replacement units)
rules.status_basis: Ordinance is in the Los Angeles Municipal Code and described as current law.

requires.text: rental properties that were first built on or before October 1, 1978

coverage.summary: Applies to rental units in buildings first built on or before October 1, 1978, plus replacement units.
coverage.exemptions_summary: Condominiums and townhomes are not rent-regulated for tenancies that commenced after December 31, 1995.

rules.title: Rent Stabilization Ordinance (RSO) – Legal Reasons for Eviction
rules.requirement: RSO units may be evicted only for listed at-fault or no-fault reasons. No-fault evictions require a Landlord Declaration of Intent to Evict, 30- and 60-day written notice (some 120 days or longer), and relocation assistance; eviction notices must be filed with LAHD within three business days.
rules.key_value: Eviction notices filed with LAHD within 3 business days of service
rules.status_basis: Cited as current Los Angeles Municipal Code provisions.

requires.text: rental properties that were first built on or before October 1, 1978

coverage.summary: Applies to units subject to the RSO.

rules.quoted_span:
All notices to terminate a tenancy for all rental units subject to
City’s Rent Stabilization Ordinance (RSO
) must be filed with the Los Angeles Housing Department (LAHD) within
three (3) business days of service on the tenant
per Los Angeles Municipal Code 151.09.C.9 & 165.05.B.5.
